top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from the incretin effect and proglucagon processing, through the identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, to drugs with confirmed glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit is mature and stable. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov are separable contributors to the discovery, and a physiology-centred citation keeps discovery distinct from drug development. Attribution relative to Habener remains the weak point, but it does not outweigh the merit of the award.
